checks: Two real Compose services interleave chronologically; both JSON and plain log lines present.
Multi-select excludes logx-a; error plus payment search shows only logx-b payment errors.
JSON row expands to indented nested data.
All three time-range controls issue scoped requests and return bounded snapshots.
Pausing stops polling; manual refresh works paused; resuming immediately fetches and then polls again.
The throwaway project's empty default environment shows no fixture logs.
Malformed range=400, unknown project=403, anonymous API request=401.
Pausing before the initial response displays the paused state instead of an endless spinner.
